# Carlos de Ory

> Carlos de Ory started his first business at 16 and has been building companies for more than 20 years: Happy Low Cost, StartupsMansion, SupportNear, Eco Beach City (Sumba, Indonesia), RealHunt and SurfRanking. He runs the marketing of his travel and real estate companies with AI agents (ad monitoring, lead response, daily publishing and reporting), with more than 20 million euros sold in real estate through AI-led marketing. He gives keynotes in English and Spanish and leads growth marketing for companies. In 2022 Forbes España included him in its list of the 100 most creative people in business. Operated by Equinox Investment Group LLC.

Contact: use the form at https://www.carlosdeory.com/#contact (no public email or phone).

## Work with Carlos
- [Speaking](https://www.carlosdeory.com/speaking/) ([en español](https://www.carlosdeory.com/charlas/)): keynotes for conferences, companies and universities, in English or Spanish, 30-60 minutes.
- [Growth marketing](https://www.carlosdeory.com/growth/) ([en español](https://www.carlosdeory.com/agencia/)): strategy, Meta and Google ads, SEO, content, funnels and automation.
- [About Carlos](https://www.carlosdeory.com/about-me/): biography year by year.
- [Press](https://www.carlosdeory.com/prensa/): Forbes España, Antena 3 and other media.
- [Press release, 7 Nov 2026: court case dismissed](https://www.carlosdeory.com/press/court-case-dismissed/) ([en español](https://www.carlosdeory.com/prensa/sobreseimiento-audiencia-nacional/)): on 21 September 2026 Spain's Audiencia Nacional (Tribunal Central de Instancia, Investigating Section, Court no. 1), at the Public Prosecutor's request, dismissed and archived preliminary proceedings 58/2025 (alleged fraud) against Carlos de Ory and Eco Beach City because the offence was not proven. Police and UDEF found real investment activity, over €2 million paid for land and over €3 million returned to investors; Spain's Interior Attaché saw 20 glampings and 4 villas built on Sumba. As far as we know, no one has appealed. Court order PDF: https://www.carlosdeory.com/assets/cdo/docs/auto-sobreseimiento-audiencia-nacional-2026-09-21.pdf (CSV E04799402-MI:foYu-bCjN-37fU-zk2a-L).

## Projects
- Eco Beach City: a town by the sea on Sumba, Indonesia, one hour from Bali.
- Happy Low Cost: travel deals community, 300,000+ flights booked through its deals.
- RealHunt: ranking of homes scored by value.
- SupportNear: free map of places where anyone can eat, sleep, shower or get help, in 147 countries.
- MejorCrucero: cruise comparison.
